office: Representative, City of San Juan Lone District
role: District Representative · San Juan City, Lone District
profileLabel: Liberal-leaning social values (low confidence); slight center-left economics (low confidence)
summary: San Juan representative with 77 principal-authored bills. Authored married women keeping maiden surnames, equality in marriage and family, definitions of electronic violence and violence against women in politics, freelance worker protection, a higher individual income-tax exemption ceiling, fuel excise suspension, raised campaign expense limits, changed candidate-substitution grounds and penal code revisions. Co-authored the national minimum wage.
caveat: Penal code revisions were not reviewed. Raised campaign expense limits and changed candidate-substitution grounds are one electoral issue, so democratic institutions is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored freelance worker protection (-2) and co-authored national minimum wage (-2); higher individual income-tax exemption (-1), travel-tax abolition and fuel excise suspension neutral. Labor and taxation: two issues.
